name: Auto-draft product marketing context from codebase
prompt: Set up product marketing context for our product
expected_behavior: Checks for existing .agents/<productname>/product.md
If exists, summarizes what's captured and asks what to update
If not, offers auto-draft from codebase or start from scratch
Walks through sections conversationally, one at a time
Pushes for verbatim customer language
Saves to .agents/<productname>/product.md

name: Update existing context with new competitor
prompt: Update our product product marketing context — we have a new competitor called Kahoot
expected_behavior: Reads existing .agents/<productname>/product.md
Navigates to the Competitive Landscape section
Researches Kahoot
Adds it as a direct competitor with positioning analysis
Asks for confirmation before saving

name: Create personas for our product
prompt: Create buyer personas for our product target region
expected_behavior: Identifies multi-sided market: Students, Parents, Teachers, School Leaders
Creates persona profiles with JTBD, pain points, and decision triggers
Uses target region-specific context (Curriculum Board syllabus, [Local Payment Gateway]/[Local Payment Gateway], exam seasons)
Distinguishes between users (students) and buyers (parents/school leaders)
References buyer-personas-framework.md reference file

name: Positioning statement for our product
prompt: Write a positioning statement for our product target region
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for context
Creates positioning statement targeting primary segment
Differentiates from free alternatives (YouTube, Free Online Study Notes)
Highlights dialogic pedagogy and Curriculum Board syllabus alignment
Follows chatty iterative approach

name: Check legacy file locations
prompt: I think I have a product marketing file somewhere
expected_behavior: Checks .agents/<productname>/product.md (canonical location)
Also checks .claude/product-marketing.md (legacy)
Also checks product-marketing-context.md (legacy filename)
If found in non-canonical location, offers to move it
Does not create duplicate files
